In this presentation, you will discuss your statistical analysis plan and study design for the Alzheimer's disease project from homework 3. 

+ Limit your presentation to 10 slides.
+ Limit your presentation to 5 minutes + 2 minutes for questions.

You will be graded on the following criteria:

+ Clarity of the study design and statistical analysis plan.
+ Clarity of the presentation.
+ Design of the presentation.

Include one slide that makes a design trade-off visible (for example, power, cost, and dropout) and one slide on the most important assumption or risk. If AI helped prepare the deck, disclose its bounded role in speaker notes; be ready to explain and defend every quantitative claim.
